description:
The application is set up to receive shared content at **https://example.com/share-receiver** using an HTTP **POST** request, with the form encoded as **multipart/form-data**. When a share is initiated, the title of the item is passed in the field named **sharedTitle**. The message body is supplied directly as the text **“Here is some shared text from the source application.”**, and the URL of the shared resource is provided as **https://example.com/shared-resource**.

Any accompanying files are uploaded through the form field **sharedFiles**. This field accepts files whose MIME types match **image/*** (any image format) or whose extensions are **.pdf**, allowing users to share images and PDF documents alongside the other share data.
